caveats: flat calls into a flop pot (open-call, multiway calls) are valued by the static continuation (positional realization vs SPR); observed at 15 bb: BB defends ~100 % vs a 2.0 open from every seat (fold <= 0.05 %) because with the 1 bb ante the call needs ~18 % realized equity - call vs fold there is model-dependent and a refinement target; all-in decisions (jam, call a jam, 3-bet jam) do not use the continuation model
